info.title: Forge
info.description:
Backend API for the **KamiLimu Forge** mentorship programme: cohorts, sessions,
attendance, points and graduation tracking, extra activities, dashboards,
leaderboards, notifications and analytics.

## Authentication

1. An admin invites a user (`POST /auth/invite`, `/auth/bulk-invite` or `/auth/bulk-invite/csv`).
2. The user activates their account with the emailed token (`POST /auth/activate`).
3. `POST /auth/login` returns an access token (1h) and a refresh token (7d).
4. Send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` on every request
   (use the **Authorize** button above).
5. `POST /auth/refresh` rotates the pair; `POST /auth/logout` revokes it.

## Conventions

* **Errors** share one shape: `{"success": false, "error": "<code>", "detail": ...}`.
* **Pagination**: list endpoints take `page` (from 1) and `page_size` (max 100) and
  return `{items, total, page, page_size, total_pages}`.
* **Rate limiting**: login, activation and reset requests are limited per client IP;
  over the limit you get `429`.
* **Access control**: users see their own records, peer mentors their group,
  committee members their cohort, and admins everything.

## Roles

`admin`, `committee`, `mentee`, `peer_mentor_1:1`, `peer_mentor_ict`,
`professional_mentor`, `partner`, `alumni`.

post.description:
Invite a user by email. **Admin only.**

The invitation link expires after `INVITATION_TOKEN_EXPIRE_DAYS` (default 7).
Roles are granted on activation, scoped to `cohort_id` when given, in which case
the user is also enrolled in that cohort.

Invite many users at once (e.g. a whole cohort). **Admin only.**

Each user is processed independently; the response reports success or the
failure reason per email.

Invite users from a CSV upload. **Admin only.**

Columns: `email,first_name,last_name,roles`. Separate multiple roles with `;`,
e.g. `peer_mentor_1:1;alumni`. Invalid rows are reported and skipped.

get.description: Validate an invitation token and return who it is for (used by the activation page).

post.description:
Activate an invited account by setting a password; returns a token pair.

Password rules: at least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase
letter and a digit.

Exchange email and password for an access token (1h) and refresh token (7d).

Send the access token as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.
Rotate tokens: the submitted refresh token is revoked and a new pair issued.
Revoke the current access token, and the refresh token if supplied.

Email a password reset link (valid 24h).

Always succeeds, so the response never reveals whether an account exists.
Set a new password using the token from the reset email.

post.description:
Enroll a user in the cohort and grant the matching cohort-scoped role.

Mentees can be assigned a 1:1 `peer_mentor_id` (who must be enrolled as
`peer_mentor_1:1`) and an `ict_track` offered by the cohort.

peer mentors, their group's.

post.description:
Schedule a session. **Committee of the cohort or admin.**

Publishing (`status: published`) opens an attendance window based on the
category (Thursday: 24h after the end, Saturday: 48h, peer mentorship: the
explicit deadline) and notifies the cohort.

get.description:
Sessions in the caller's cohorts, filterable by cohort, track, month, status and date.
Drafts are only listed for committee and admins.

Session details including mentors, resources, reschedule history and its
attendance window.

patch.description:
Edit session details, publish a draft or mark it completed. Use
`/reschedule` to change its time.

delete.description: Cancel a session. Its window closes and it no longer counts towards points.

post.description:
Move a session. The original time and every change are kept in
`reschedule_history`, the attendance window is recomputed (dropping
per-mentee overrides) and attendees are notified.

put.description: Replace the lead and co-mentors assigned to a session.

patch.description:
Replace the session's material links (slides, recordings, Drive folders).
Allowed for staff and the session's mentors.

post.description:
Record your attendance and feedback for a session. **Mentees only.**

Allowed only while the session's attendance window (or your approved
override) is open. Ratings (1–5) apply only when `status` is `attended`.
